program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # diff pair L
    "Itail": (32e-6, 20e-6, 80e-6),  # first-stage tail current
    "Lp":    (2.0, 0.5, 3.0),        # PMOS mirror-load L
    "L6":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # 2nd-stage PMOS L
    "I6":    (160e-6, 80e-6, 400e-6),# 2nd-stage current
    "Cc":    (1.0e-12, 0.5e-12, 2.5e-12),
    "rzk":   (1.6, 0.8, 4.0),        # Rz = rzk / gm6
    "Ln":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),        # NMOS current-mirror L
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I6, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I6"], p["Cc"]
    I1 = It / 2

    # differential pair + PMOS mirror load
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.4)
    m3 = lut.size("p", 8.0, p["Lp"], I1, vds=1.1)
    # second stage
    m6 = lut.size("p", 10.0, p["L6"], I6, vds=0.9)
    # NMOS mirrors (same L and gm/Id)
    gmn = 10.0
    mb = lut.size("n", gmn, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.7)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmn, p["Ln"], It, vds=0.3)
    m7 = lut.size("n", gmn, p["Ln"], I6, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["rzk"] / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    # first stage: vinn on diode side, vinp on output side (non-inverting overall)
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # second stage
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    # Miller compensation with nulling resistor
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # predictions
    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    C2 = CL + m6.cdd + m7.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * Cc / (C1 * C2 + Cc * (C1 + C2)) / (2 * PI)
    denom = (1 / m6.gm - Rz)
    zph = 0.0
    if abs(denom) > 1e-12:
        fz = 1 / (2 * PI * Cc * abs(denom))
        zph = math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fz)) * (1 if denom < 0 else -1)
    p3 = 1 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + zph - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3))
    m_mirror = m3.gm / (2 * m3.cgg) / (2 * PI)
    pm -= math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / m_mirror)) / 2
    slew = min(It / Cc, I6 / (CL + Cc))
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    thermal = math.sqrt(16 * kT / 3 / m1.gm * (1 + m3.gm / m1.gm))
    noise_1k = thermal * 8  # rough flicker multiplier at 1 kHz
    psrr_db = gain_db - 6
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "noise_1k": noise_1k, "psrr_db": psrr_db,
               "power": 1.8 * (iref + It + I6)}

events.topology: Two-stage Miller (NMOS input, PMOS mirror load, PMOS CS 2nd stage, Rz-Cc compensation)
